originalTitle: U.S. stock futures muted after chip losses drag Wall Street; CPI data awaited
summary: Investing.com-- U.S. stock futures were little changed on Tuesday evening after Wall Street ended lower on chipmaker losses, as investors awaited September's consumer inflation report for clues on the Federal Reserve's interest-rate outlook.
content:
Investing.com-- U.S. stock futures were little changed on Tuesday evening after Wall Street ended lower on chipmaker losses, as investors awaited September's consumer inflation report for clues on the Federal Reserve's interest-rate outlook.

S&P 500 Futures traded flat at 7,855.75 points, while Nasdaq 100 Futures were unchanged at 30,793.75 points by 20:34 ET (00:34 GMT). Dow Jones Futures edged down 0.1% to 51,894.0 points.

In the regular session, the S&P 500 ended largely flat, while the Nasdaq Composite lost 0.2% and the Dow Jones Industrial Average dropped 0.4%.

Semiconductor stocks remained under pressure, with the Philadelphia Semiconductor Index falling for a fifth consecutive session.

Micron Technology (NASDAQ:MU) fell 3.6%, and Applied Materials (NASDAQ:AMAT) dropped nearly 7%.

Not finding the right stocks? Our AI's list of investor-grade stock picks for October just dropped »

Concerns about growing competition from China's ChangXin Memory Technologies and uncertainty over returns from artificial intelligence investments weighed on sentiment. Broadcom (NASDAQ:AVGO) Chief Executive Hock Tan had compared some investment flows into the sector to casino gambling, adding to concerns about elevated valuations and speculative spending.

Investors were also assessing mixed third-quarter results from major U.S. banks at the start of the earnings season.

Citigroup (NYSE:C) fell 5.6% despite beating profit expectations, while Goldman Sachs (NYSE:GS) slipped 0.2%.

Wells Fargo (NYSE:WFC) dropped 3.1% after its net interest income missed estimates, and JPMorgan (NYSE:JPM) declined 0.9% after reporting a rare quarterly profit shortfall.

The focus now shifts to Wednesday's consumer price index report, which could influence expectations for the Federal Reserve's next policy moves. Economists expect the September data to provide a clearer picture of inflation pressures as higher energy costs and geopolitical tensions complicate the outlook.

Oil prices, government bond yields and developments in the Middle East remain key drivers of market sentiment. Brent prices rose in Asian trading Wednesday to near $107 per barrel.

Elevated crude prices have raised concerns that inflation could prove persistent, potentially limiting the central bank's scope to ease monetary policy. Traders widely expect the Fed to hold interest rates steady this month, although a rate increase in December remains a possibility.

Investing.com——周二晚间，华尔街因芯片制造商亏损而收低，美国股指期货几乎没有变化，投资者正在等待 9 月份的消费者通胀报告，以获取有关美联储利率前景的线索。

截至美国东部时间 20:34（格林威治标准时间 00:34），标准普尔 500 指数期货持平于 7,855.75 点，而纳斯达克 100 期货则持平于 30,793.75 点。道琼斯期货微跌 0.1%，至 51,894.0 点。

常规交易时段，标准普尔 500 指数基本持平，纳斯达克综合指数下跌 0.2%，道琼斯工业平均指数下跌 0.4%。

半导体股仍然承压，费城半导体指数连续第五个交易日下跌。

美光科技 (NASDAQ:MU) 下跌 3.6%，应用材料 (NASDAQ:AMAT) 下跌近 7%。

找不到合适的股票？我们的人工智能 10 月份投资者级股票精选名单刚刚下降 »

对中国长鑫存储技术公司日益激烈的竞争以及人工智能投资回报的不确定性的担忧打压了市场情绪。博通（纳斯达克股票代码：AVGO）首席执行官 Hock Tan 将流入该行业的一些投资与赌场赌博进行了比较，加剧了人们对估值上升和投机性支出的担忧。

在财报季开始时，投资者还评估了美国主要银行第三季度的业绩好坏参半。

尽管盈利超出预期，花旗集团 (NYSE:C) 仍下跌 5.6%，高盛 (NYSE:GS) 下跌 0.2%。

富国银行 (NYSE:WFC) 因净利息收入低于预期而下跌 3.1%，摩根大通 (NYSE:JPM) 因报告罕见的季度利润缺口而下跌 0.9%。

现在焦点转向周三的消费者价格指数报告，该报告可能会影响对美联储下一步政策举措的预期。经济学家预计，由于能源成本上升和地缘政治紧张局势使前景变得复杂，9月份的数据将更清晰地反映通胀压力。

油价、政府债券收益率和中东事态发展仍然是市场情绪的主要驱动因素。周三亚洲交易中布伦特原油价格上涨至每桶 107 美元附近。

原油价格上涨引发了人们对通胀可能持续存在的担忧，这可能会限制央行放松货币政策的范围。交易员普遍预计美联储本月将维持利率稳定，但 12 月仍有可能加息。
